author: Daniel Greene
description:
Can you solve the perfect murder?

Today I’m breaking down one of the most famous mystery novels ever written — And Then There Were None by Agatha Christie — and attempting to solve it before the final reveal.

This book is often called the greatest murder mystery of all time. But is it actually solvable? Are the clues fair? Let’s freakin do this mystery solving thing.
title: Can I Solve Literature's Greatest Murder Mystery?
